The 13 Core Micro-Engines (~58KB Total)

Composable, progressive, and ultra-lean extensions designed for Hollywood-grade web engineering.

⚡ HxBolt (~16KB)

Proxy-based reactive signals, computed props, $store, 2D sparse matrix, and 120 FPS ticker.

📱 AppzOS (~6.5KB)

Mobile/Spatial OS runtime with 8 viewport modes, 0-9 Photoshop Z-layers, coroutines, and haptics.

🔍 HxFlash (~4.8KB)

0ms in-memory fuzzy search with typo tolerance and TypedArray columnar query engine.

🪟 HxVirtual (~3.9KB)

Bi-directional 2D windowing virtualization with pinned rows and columns for million-row tables.

📊 HxCalc (~3.2KB)

Topological formula DAG engine, coordinate ranges (SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX), and cycle detector.

⚙️ HxSim (~4.2KB)

Deterministic physics simulator with Verlet integration, N-body gravitational fields, and spring chains.

📝 HxForm (~5.1KB)

Declarative validation, optimistic cell transactions, and multi-level undo/redo stacks.

🌊 HxVibe (~3.4KB)

FLIP layout transitions, analytical spring physics solver, magnetic cursor pull, 3D card tilt.

♿ HxA11y (~3.1KB)

Modal focus trapping, 2D roving tabindex matrix navigation, Excel range keyboard selection.

📶 HxOffline (~2.1KB)

IndexedDB mutation queue with exponential backoff and automatic background sync.

🛠️ HxDevTools (~1.8KB)

Real-time signal inspector, swap latency timing HUD, and autonomous @diag streams.

📐 HxGrid (~2.8KB)

Multi-track auto-responsive grid layouts, subgrid synchronization, and dynamic masonry distribution.

🎨 HxCanvas (~3.5KB)

Spatial node editor with draggable nodes, grid auto-snapping, and elastic Bézier connectors.
